description: This file defines a TaskObserver class in Python that manages multiple observer instances for a pipeline, using asyncio for concurrency and task management. It creates proxies for each observer to avoid blocking the main pipeline during frame processing and handles observer lifecycle management.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A data class that stores information about a proxied observer, including its queue, task, and the observer instance itself.

classes.name: TaskObserver
classes.description: A proxy observer that manages multiple downstream observers without blocking the pipeline execution. It creates separate asyncio tasks and queues for each observer to process frames asynchronously.

methods.name: add_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Adds a new observer to the managed list and creates a proxy if the observer system is already started.

methods.name: remove_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Removes an observer and cancels its associated asyncio task.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Initializes proxies for all registered observers and starts their processing tasks.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations, including calling the superclass cleanup and cleaning up each proxy.

methods.name: on_process_frame(self, data: FrameProcessed)
methods.description: Queues a FrameProcessed event to all proxies for processing.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Queues a FramePushed event to all proxies for processing.

methods.name: Proxy _create_proxy(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for an individual observer, including its queue and task.

methods.name: Dict[BaseObserver,Proxy] _create_proxies(self, observers: List[BaseObserver])
methods.description: Creates proxies for all observers in the managed list.

methods.name: _send_to_proxy(self, data: Any)
methods.description: Sends frame data to all observer proxies by putting the data into their queues.

methods.name: _proxy_task_handler(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Processing coroutine that handles events for a specific observer, processing queued frames asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, task_manager: BaseTaskManager, **kwargs, )
